parsed.note_claim: El nuevo Lord Mayor de Leicester, Kulwinder Singh Johal, no es musulmán, es de origen sij.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Guided by his Sikh faith and the principle of seva (selfless service), he has volunteered for decades and is committed to serving every resident of Leicester with openness, respect and humility.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states the Lord Mayor is guided by his Sikh faith, confirming the note's correction regarding his religion.
